a: Stuffing too much irrelevant context can reduce answer quality.
Models may underuse information placed in the middle of long contexts.
Ask models to cite retrieved snippets for verifiable answers.
Function calling lets models request structured tool executions.
Agents iterate plan → act → observe until done or limits hit.
Long-term memory stores facts outside the context window.
Rubrics score answers on correctness, helpfulness, and safety.
Keep a fixed prompt suite to detect quality regressions.
Cap max tokens and cache frequent prompts to control cost.
Safety filters block or rewrite disallowed content.
